answer.reason: In the EIA Louisiana Electricity Profile 2024, Table 1 (Net generation by sector) reports IPP & CHP (Independent Power Producers and Combined Heat and Power) net generation of 34,738,394 megawatthours. This is consistent with Louisiana's overall net generation of roughly 100 million MWh, of which the electric utility sector accounts for the larger share (on the order of 65 million MWh) and IPP & CHP accounts for roughly a third. Option B's 64,884,441 MWh is too large to be the IPP & CHP figure and corresponds instead to the electric utility sector, so the supported answer is A.
